text: {"name":"llc_rx_event_save","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Advances a link's receive-event timing across missed intervals, checks due LLC PDUs, and updates its position in the shared event list.","subsystem":"llc","var_renames":{"v3":"scheduler_state","v4":"link_state_table","v7":"link_event_list","v11":"scheduled_event","v12":"event_scan_deadline","v15":"active_event_record","v16":"record_timestamp","v17":"event_timeout_deadline","v21":"event_interval"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":72,"meaning":"Event discriminator compared with the active scheduled-event record."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Per-link event-list head."},{"offset":80,"meaning":"Current event timestamp, updated from the timestamp argument."},{"offset":84,"meaning":"Index used to select link state from the link-state table."},{"offset":85,"meaning":"Bit 0 requests ioctl handling and is cleared after handling."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Timing mode that selects the event-interval source or units."},{"offset":116,"meaning":"Index used to select an event interval from the interval table."},{"offset":222,"meaning":"Interval value used when timing mode 2 is active."},{"offset":1224,"meaning":"Enable byte for the LLC PDU check."},{"offset":1225,"meaning":"Link index used by the LLC PDU check."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Scheduled-event node timestamp."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Scheduled-event node link index."}]}
